subject: The data that 0.3% of users see
preview_text: You earned something rare. Check your Predictify inbox for a surprise.
body_paragraphs: 68 days ago, you downloaded Predictify. Since then, you’ve seen the AI call matches before kickoff, watched your streak grow, and probably flexed a few correct predictions in your fan group. But here’s the thing: most users never make it this far. You’re in the top 0.3% of users who stick around long enough to unlock something special.

I wanted to say thank you. Not with a generic pop-up or a push notification, but with something real. So I went through the data and found a set of predictions that our AI flagged as its most confident calls for the upcoming weekend. These aren’t the ones we show everyone. They’re the insider picks—the ones we reserve for users who’ve truly engaged with the app. You’ve earned a sneak peek at them, no strings attached.

Open Predictify and head to your personal insights tab. You’ll see a new card called ‘Your Insider Batch’ with three matches the AI rates at 89% confidence or higher. It’s a direct look at the model’s top picks, something only long-term users like you get. Tap into any match for the full tactical breakdown and player stats—xG, defensive gaps, everything. This is the stuff that turns guesswork into a conversation starter.

Check it out now before the weekend kicks off. And if you want to see the full picture behind every prediction, the Premium tier unlocks the entire feed of confident calls for $12.99 a month with a 3-day trial. P.S. The AI Chat can break down any of those Insider Batch matches in real time—just ask it ‘Why does the model rate this game so high?’ and watch it spill the data.
